c1-17-001.gate_key: adv_part | C1 | gap | ___ with the other candidates, she was clearly the strongest. (compare) |

item.q: ___ with the other candidates, she was clearly the strongest. (compare)
item.why: The candidate is the one being compared, so the participle is passive: *Compared with the other candidates, she was…* Compare *Judging by the queue*: there the speaker judges.
item.why_lv: Kandidāte *tiek* salīdzināta ar *citiem*, tāpēc 3. forma ir ciešamajā kārtā: *Compared with the other candidates, she was*… Salīdzini ar *Judging by the queue*: tur spriež runātājs.

accepted: She denied having read the letter.
She denied ever having read the letter.

item.q: Report what she said with *deny* and *having*. Her words: 'I didn't read the letter.'
item.why: *deny* + *having* + 3rd form for something earlier than the denying: *She denied having read the letter.* (*She denied reading the letter* is natural too, but this task asks for *having*.)
item.why_lv: *deny + having* + 3. forma tam, kas notika pirms noliegšanas: *She denied having read the letter.* (*Dabiski* ir arī *She denied reading the letter*, bet šis *uzdevums* prasa *having*.)
answers: She denied having read the letter.
She denied ever having read the letter.
She has denied having read the letter.

c1-17-003.gate_key: adv_present | C1 | mcq | In this story, which verb gives the background, not an event that moves the story on? So I'm sitting on the train, this man opens a bag of crisps, everyone turns round, and he just smiles. | 'm sitting

item.q: In this story, which verb gives the background, not an event that moves the story on? So I'm sitting on the train, this man opens a bag of crisps, everyone turns round, and he just smiles.
item.why: In a story told in the present, the background is usually in the present continuous (*I'm sitting on the train*) and the events that move the story on are in the present simple (*opens, turns round, smiles*).
item.why_lv: Stāstā tagadnē fons parasti ir Present Continuous (*I'm sitting on the train*), bet notikumi, kas *virza* stāstu, ir Present Simple (*opens, turns round, smiles*).
